oracle.method: Separate free-dock/inventory/cargo ledger; independent Haversine/cost, attempt accounting and summary metrics; no production helpers

controlled_fixture.decision: No operational recommendation. Optimizer improves no-action in 9/9 cells, ties heuristic in 3/9 and loses in 6/9; surrogate optimum is not minimum simulated loss.

assumptions: SCENARIO ONLY: Poisson attempts use published observed trip forecasts as means, not latent-demand estimates.
Independent station/hour/type counts; returns are exogenous, not linked to simulated rentals. Fleet is an open subsystem.
Uniform within-hour events or all departures/arrivals in the first half-hour; demand scales are assumptions, not fitted intervals.
No demand is modeled between as-of and the next complete forecast hour; lead-in hold may be optimistic.
GBFS operating flags and capacity remain fixed after as-of; disabled/unknown slots capacity-bikes-docks stay blocked.
GBFS TTL validates the INITIAL snapshot only, not future observations over the simulation horizon.
All transport departs at as-of; one direct loaded trip per vehicle, no fleet reuse, depot routing or operator cost claims.
Haversine/specified speed plus handling gives scenario travel times, not measured street routes.
Delivery wins exact-time ties, then station/type/sequence; undeliverable cargo remains on its vehicle to horizon end.
Optimizer is optimal only for L1 inventory-target + weighted movement-cost surrogate; simulated losses can worsen.
Risk is ever-empty/full fraction including initial state among assumed draws; Monte Carlo Wilson intervals are not calibration.
No field validation/operational uplift/economic saving claim; Seasonal Naive/unavailable F4 fallback retained.
resources_scope: Shared-host warm/cache state; simulation timer excludes source adapter; full CLI includes adapter and new run; RSS is process high-water, not isolated marginal policy RAM or SLA.

optimization_method.solver: scipy.optimize.milp / bundled HiGHS, existing locked ML group; no new dependency
optimization_method.targets: clip((bikes+docks)/2 + sum_departures*scale - sum_arrivals*scale,0,bikes+docks); zero demand -> initial bikes
optimization_method.objective: sum abs(initial_bikes - outbound + inbound - target) + cost_weight*(bike_km*cost_per_bike_km + vehicles*cost_per_vehicle)
optimization_method.constraints: integer nonnegative x_ij/y_ij; x<=vehicle_capacity*y; sum y<=vehicles; outgoing<=initial bikes; incoming<=initial docks; installed/renting donor and installed/returning receiver; arrival inside horizon
optimization_method.stop: <=10 seconds default, <=10000 nodes, mip_rel_gap=0; nonoptimal -> unavailable plan, partial run, no active promotion
optimization_method.heuristic: Independent high>0.75 / low<0.25 stock ratio; nearest direct pairs, target midpoint; no action for zero demand
optimization_method.cost_units: relative scenario units, not company money; no vehicle reuse/real street routing
